title: Recruited by two men to work as an airplane mechanic as cover
place_text: Air Force training pipeline; Pope Air Force Base, North Carolina

tellings.quote: somewhere early on in the the pipeline I was approached by two individuals who convinced me that um it would be a good idea if I became an airplane mechanic.

plain: In the mid-1990s, early in his Air Force training, a former military helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says two men approached him and convinced him it would be a good idea to become an airplane mechanic, a job he describes as a cover, which led to Pope Air Force Base in North Carolina. Barber tells this as his own experience. He tells it as how he was first drawn into secret work.
